tests.title: A unit sold in Web POS is no longer available to the eShop when both sell from the same warehouse
tests.goal: In-store and online sales share one stock count, so the last unit cannot be sold twice.
preconditions: A store whose POS warehouse also serves Online Shop, found at runtime (Physical Stores POS > View, Add Transfer Order warehouse labels); skip with a clear note if no warehouse is shared
A product with available = 1 in that warehouse
data: Tender: Cash only (POS); Bank Transfer only (eShop)

steps.text: Web POS: sell 1 unit to a QA member (Cash)
eShop: open the product page and try to add 1 unit, then open /checkout
CRM: read the product row in Inventory and Inventory History

expected.text: Step 2: the product is shown as sold out / Add To Cart is refused, or checkout flags it and will not place the order
Step 3: Available 0 for the warehouse and a history row for the POS sale
Cleanup: refund the POS sale (SCRM-086) so the unit comes back

notes: Variant without mapping change: Tee testing S-B (Office 4, TaiPo 0). eShop Add To Cart 5 refused / 4 accepted; POS Storeberry KN (Office) cash sale TXN1226102800001 of 1; then 4 refused ('Not enough quantity for this product') / 3 accepted. Checkout shows SOLD OUT (TaiPo only, BUG-017 accepted). Sale refunded (Cash), Office back to 4.

tests.title: A second partial refund cannot exceed the amount still paid on the order
tests.goal: Staff cannot refund more money than the customer paid.
preconditions: The order from the partial refund case after product 1 was refunded

steps.text: Start another refund and enter an amount larger than the remaining paid amount (remaining + 0.10)
Enter exactly the remaining amount and confirm

expected.text: Step 1: refused with a message; nothing is refunded
Step 2: accepted; order fully Refunded; total refunded = amount paid
Step 3: Refund is no longer offered, or offers HKD 0.00 and cannot be confirmed

notes: Refund edited to 900 on 812.50 remaining (TXN0126102800015) and 2100 on a 2088 order (TXN0126102800017) both completed.

tests.title: Reaching the level spending threshold upgrades the member, gives the upgrade reward and the new level discount
tests.goal: Member levels and their rewards follow the configured spending thresholds.
preconditions: A QA member close to the next level (e.g. MEMy001164526: Level 2, $1176 or $717 / $2000 as of 2026-10-28)
Thresholds and Upgrade Reward points read from Loyalty Setting at runtime

steps.text: Place an eShop order whose net total takes level spending just over the next threshold, upload a receipt and accept it in the CRM
Read My Account (Member Level, level spending, Point History) and the CRM customer profile
Add a product to the cart and open /checkout

expected.text: Step 2: Member Level = next level; "Upgrade Reward" points = configured amount; spending = old + net total
Step 2: the CRM customer profile shows the same level
Step 3: the new level's basket promotion is applied instead of the old one

notes: Member Level 1 (spending 0, 650 pts) -> TXN0126102800016 C x4 net 2088 accepted -> Level 3, spending 88 / 3000, +208 points (10%); CRM list Level 3; checkout then applies Gold 20% (600 -> 480). No Upgrade Reward entry (config unknown, see case notes).
